CheckOut.description:
Whether a completed scan passes a threshold and a minimum coverage, on the server
(MartianSecurity/martian-notes#400, #402). The gate policy file (#470) is read into these terms.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

MatchCounts.description: How this scan's findings compare with the subject's earlier scans (MartianSecurity/martian-notes#403).
MatchCounts.title: MatchCounts

ReferenceOut.description:
One reference of a scan and what resolving it found (MartianSecurity/martian-notes#434), in the shape of
the scanner's contract (``#/$defs/reference``) plus the findings that cite it.
ReferenceOut.title: ReferenceOut

ScanFindingOut.description: A finding with its receipts, as the scan record and the JSON export hold it.
ScanFindingOut.title: ScanFindingOut

TrackOut.description: One finding of a subject across its scans, as it stands now.
TrackOut.title: TrackOut

TriageOut.description: The answer to a triage action; its top-level fields are the audit log entry's details.
TriageOut.title: TriageOut

TriageState.description:
The triage behind a finding's status: an acceptance (with its reason, member and end) and the
waiver that holds, if any.
TriageState.title: TriageState

info.description: The customer /v1/scanner routes of the hosted backend (not the worker's). Generated from the backend's routes; do not edit by hand.
info.title: Martian Scanner scan API

archive.description: A ZIP file; the second part

manifest.description: JSON, at most 16 KiB; the first part
manifest.title: UploadManifest

200.description: The scan as JSON or SARIF 2.1.0
